description: The account's AI context: what the blog is about, its pricing tiers, value props, testimonials, design direction and tone presets. Every AI-personalised lead magnet is generated from exactly this plus the visitor's own answers. It belongs to the whole account and is shared by every website on it, so a connection limited to one website can read it but not change it.

project.description: A project id from list_projects. Runs this call in that project instead of the connection default.

name: read_ai_context
title: Read ai context
